def is_palindrome(text: str):
    """
    Checks if given string is a palindrome
    >>> is_palindrome('')
    True
    >>> is_palindrome('aba')
    True
    >>> is_palindrome('aaaaa')
    True
    >>> is_palindrome('zbcd')
    False
    """
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise TypeError("Input must be a string")
    left, right = 0, len(text) - 1
    while left < right:
        if text[left] != text[right]:
            return False
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return True
